lara: Postmortem follow-up: token-count overcount + delayed ingestion incident. Thanks for the writeup earlier. Need to lock owners for remediation actions and timelines. Quick check-in.

sam: Deployed hotfix to ingestion dedupe yesterday at 03:10 UTC. Should stop immediate dupes; still verifying backfill.

ops-bot: Ticket BILL-482 created for ingestion backfill (owner: sam).

jin: For invoice corrections: plan is run CRON backfill 2-phase — phase 1 identify duplicates + credits, phase 2 reissue invoices. Target: 2-week runway. Owner: jin. I'll need a ledger export and impacted-account list.

maria: Customer comms draft in #support. Timeline: credits applied within 3 business days after verification; reissued invoices within 10 business days. Need list of impacted accounts by EOD Fri.

sam: I can produce impacted-account list by tomorrow 12:00 PT. I'll upload S3 path s3://redwood-metering/backfill/1765-dup-list.csv

lara: Assigning action items: sam -> backfill plan + impacted list; jin -> invoice correction runbook + chargeback logic; maria -> customer comms + tracking; eva -> escalation to enterprise CS for top 10; I'll own retrospective writeup and postmortem close. Please add GitHub issues and link tickets to BILL-482.

eva: I'll ping CS lead for top 10 accounts. @maria can you add the customer-facing FAQ in the doc? :+1:

```python
python scripts/run_backfill.py --dry-run --since=2026-03-01
```

ops-bot: Reminder: Retrospective meeting scheduled Thu 10:00 PT. Calendar invite sent.

eva: For recurring pattern detection — I recommend we add a recurring sensor in metering monitors to catch ingest spikes > 2x baseline. I'll add to OKR 4.2.

lara: Thanks. Action owners: sam, jin, maria, eva. I'll close loop after dry-run validation. If no objections I'll mark the postmortem as 'In remediation' in tracker.

sam: No objections. I'll post the dry-run results in this thread.

jin: Will coordinate with accounting for invoice reissues. tagging @ops-bot to create BILL-483 for invoice corrections.
